_doc: One playbook per store: how to search it. The agent reads this before entering the store, logs what worked to data/attempts.jsonl, and learn.py rewrites the playbook from that log. Fields:
search_url: template with {q}, used by search-url and llm-parse, e.g. https://x.com/search?q={q}
accepts_sku: true if searching the raw style code works in this store
query_tips: free text the agent reads, e.g. 'strip hyphens from Nike SKUs here'
price_selector: for llm-parse: hint where the price lives (CSS-ish or prose)
rate_limit_s: seconds to wait between requests to this store
